notes: Mid America Motorworks lists 9427651 as GM reference for 1973-1974 front grille mounting screws (set of 12, black oxide) and also as an alternate number in a 1975-1979 parking light grille kit (primary GM 3846854; black phosphate flat head self-tapping). No thread/length given in any snippet; MAM pages returned 404 on fetch.

sources.title: 1973-1974 Front Grille Mounting Screws - Mid America Motorworks (search snippet)
sources.quote: GM reference 9427651 ... car set of 12 ... black oxide finish ... secure both the Left Hand (LH) and Right Hand (RH) front grilles

sources.title: Corvette 1975-1979 Parking Light Grilles Screw Kit - Mid America Motorworks (search snippet)
sources.quote: 10 black phosphate flat head self-tapping screws and 10 U-nuts to attach the front parking light grilles to the front fascia bumper
